meta.device: Android 17 emulator or device, app com.android.settings
meta.note: Outputs are sanitized: session ids, element ids, androidId and carrierName are replaced. Page content is the stock Settings app.

baselineTools.name: select_device
baselineTools.description: Discover/select a LOCAL device. Ask for platform if unknown; one device is auto-selected. For multiple devices, ask the user to choose, then pass deviceUdid. Next: prepare_ios_simulator for iOS simulators, then appium_session_management action=create. Skip for REMOTE servers: pass device capabilities (appium:deviceName/appium:udid) and the user-provided remoteServerUrl to session creation.

iosDeviceType.description: Required for ios: simulator or real device.

deviceUdid.description: User-selected UDID. Omit to discover devices.

baselineTools.name: appium_session_management
baselineTools.description: Manage Appium sessions. Use action=create to start a session, attach to connect to an existing one, detach to forget an attached session, delete to stop one, list to see all active sessions, or select to switch the active session.

action.description:
create: Create a new Appium session.
DEFAULT MODE (no remoteServerUrl): use unless the user explicitly provides a server URL.
- Drivers run embedded inside this MCP server; no separate Appium process is needed.
- Use select_device tool FIRST to discover devices. Ask for platform/device if unknown; do not assume a platform.
- For iOS simulators, run prepare_ios_simulator before creating the session.
- Call appium_session_management action=create with the selected platform and any returned capabilitiesHint serialized as capabilities.
- Do NOT pass remoteServerUrl for local/embedded mode. NEVER invent a localhost URL.
REMOTE SERVER MODE (only when user explicitly provides a URL):
- Skip local device selection and preparation; do not call select_device.
- Infer platform and device type from the request when possible; ask if unclear.
- Use platform=general for non-Android/iOS drivers (Windows, macOS, custom); capabilities pass through without platform defaults.
- Call appium_session_management action=create with platform, remoteServerUrl, and the requested capabilities.
- Example: "create an iOS session at http://localhost:4723" means platform=ios and remoteServerUrl=http://localhost:4723; do not discover local devices.
attach: connect to an existing remote Appium session without taking ownership of its lifecycle. Requires remoteServerUrl and sessionId; capabilities are fetched from the remote server.
detach: remove an attached session from MCP without deleting the real remote session. Defaults to the active session.
delete: delete a session and clean up resources. Defaults to the active session.
list: list managed sessions with active flag, ownership, and current context.
select: set sessionId as the active session for subsequent calls; requires sessionId.

platform.description: Required for create. For local sessions, match the platform selected via select_device. For remote sessions, infer from the request; general supports non-Android/iOS drivers (Windows, macOS, custom) and requires remoteServerUrl.

capabilities.description: Optional W3C capabilities as a JSON string, e.g. '{"appium:app":"/path/to/app","appium:platformVersion":"17.0"}'. Create: overrides defaults for ios/android; passed through as-is for general. Common keys: appium:app, appium:deviceName, appium:udid, appium:platformVersion, appium:bundleId. When using capabilitiesHint from a preparation tool, serialize the full object to JSON; preserve boolean and numeric values. Attach: optional fallback values (e.g. '{"platformName":"iOS"}'); capabilities fetched from the server take precedence.

remoteServerUrl.description: Remote Appium server URL for create or attach (e.g. http://localhost:4723). Omit to use local server for create.

sessionId.description: Required for attach and select: the existing session to connect to or activate. For delete: session to delete. For detach: attached session to forget without stopping it. Delete/detach default to the active session when omitted.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_device_control
baselineTools.description: Control device behavior: lock/unlock the screen, shake the device, or open the notifications panel. Use the action parameter to choose what to do.

action.description: Action to perform. lock: lock the device (optional seconds for timed lock). unlock: unlock the device. shake: perform shake gesture (iOS only). open_notifications: open notifications panel (Android only).

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

seconds.description: Only for action=lock: lock duration in seconds before auto-unlock. Omit to remain locked until unlock.

baselineTools.name: appium_geolocation
baselineTools.description: Get, set, or reset the device geolocation (GPS coordinates). Works on both iOS (simulators and real devices) and Android (emulators and real devices with mock location enabled). Use action=get to read current coordinates, action=set with latitude/longitude (and optional altitude for Android) to simulate a location, or action=reset to restore the system default. Note: On Android emulators, reset is not supported — use action=set to manually restore coordinates instead. On Android real devices, the mocked location may persist until the GPS cache refreshes.

action.description: Action to perform. get: read the current device geolocation. set: set the device geolocation (requires latitude and longitude; optional altitude for Android). reset: reset the geolocation to the default/system value. Not supported on Android emulators — use action=set instead.

latitude.description: Latitude value (-90 to 90). Measurement of distance north or south of the Equator. Required for: set.

longitude.description: Longitude value (-180 to 180). Measurement of distance east or west of the prime meridian. Required for: set.

altitude.description: Altitude value in meters. Android only, defaults to 0. Ignored on iOS. Used with: set.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_device_info
baselineTools.description: Get device information, battery status, or current device time in a single call. Use the "action" parameter to select which data to retrieve. Works on both iOS and Android.

action.description: Action to perform: "info" returns device model/OS/locale/etc., "battery" returns battery level and charging state, "time" returns the current device time.

format.description: Only used when action is "time". moment.js format string for the returned time. Defaults to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_file
baselineTools.description: Push or pull a file using Appium mobile extensions. action=push uses payloadBase64, action=pull returns contentBase64.

action.description: push uploads a file to device; pull downloads from device.

remotePath.description: Path to the file on the device. Android (UiAutomator2): use an absolute path (e.g. /data/local/tmp/foo.txt or /sdcard/Download/foo.txt). iOS (XCUITest): use the formats described in the Appium XCUITest file transfer guide (e.g. @com.example.app:documents/file.txt or simulator-relative paths).

payloadBase64.description: Required when action=push. Ignored when action=pull.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_driver_settings
baselineTools.description: Read or update Appium driver session settings (e.g. idle timeouts, selector waits). Use action=get to return JSON settings; action=update merges a map into the session. Works for embedded UiAutomator2/XCUITest sessions and remote WebDriver clients that support Appium settings.

action.description: get: read current Appium driver session settings (timeouts, selector waits, flags). update: merge a settings map into the session (requires settings).

settings.description: Required when action is update. Driver-specific keys (e.g. Android UiAutomator2: waitForIdleTimeout, waitForSelectorTimeout, ignoreUnimportantViews; iOS XCUITest has its own set). Use action=get first to inspect current values.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: prepare_ios_simulator
baselineTools.description: Boot an iOS/tvOS simulator, download/cache WDA, and launch it on a free per-simulator port. Pass capabilitiesHint (appium:webDriverAgentUrl) to appium_session_management action=create to reuse WDA. skipWda=true only boots. APPIUM_MCP_WDA_APP_PATH can point to an extracted WebDriverAgentRunner-Runner.app (absolute path) to skip download.

udid.description: The UDID of the iOS simulator to prepare. Use select_device to get this.

platform.description: The simulator platform to download WDA for. Default is "ios". Use "tvos" for Apple TV simulators.

skipWda.description: If true, only boot the simulator without downloading or installing WDA. Default: false.

forceRefreshWda.description: If true, re-download WDA even if already cached. Default: false.

baselineTools.name: appium_prepare_ios_real_device
baselineTools.description: Prepare signed WDA for a real iOS device. Omit provisioningProfileUuid to list profiles; ask the user to choose, highlighting recommendedForWda. Pass the chosen UUID to download, package, and sign WDA; wildcard profiles use a concrete WDA bundle ID. Downloads/unsigned IPA are cached per version; signing always reruns. Pass capabilitiesHint to appium_session_management action=create to install/launch the signed WDA. Requires macOS, Xcode 16+, and a paired developer-mode device.

udid.description: UDID of the connected iOS real device. Use select_device to discover it.

provisioningProfileUuid.description: UUID of the .mobileprovision profile to sign WDA with. If omitted, the tool returns the list of available profiles so you can ask the user to pick one.

forceRebuild.description: If true, ignore the cached WDA download and unsigned IPA and start clean. The signed IPA is always rebuilt regardless. Default: false.

baselineTools.name: appium_gesture
baselineTools.description: Perform a touch gesture. Use 'action' to choose: tap, double_tap, long_press, scroll, swipe, pinch_zoom, scroll_to_element, back. Choose scroll vs swipe by intent: scroll to browse content in a list or feed; swipe to dismiss, switch screens, navigate carousels, or pull-to-refresh (speed=fast). For drag-and-drop use appium_drag_and_drop. For custom multi-touch use appium_perform_actions.

action.description:
tap/double_tap/long_press: requires elementUUID or both x/y.
scroll/swipe: requires direction or x/y/endX/endY.
pinch_zoom: requires scale (<1 out, >1 in).
scroll_to_element: requires strategy/selector; direction up/down (default down).
Stops on a match, unchanged page source, or maxScrollAttempts. Adjust distance with scrollDistance or scrollDistancePreset.
back: system back navigation.

elementUUID.description: Element UUID for tap, double_tap, long_press, or pinch_zoom; overrides x/y for these actions. For scroll/swipe with direction, coordinates are calculated relative to this element instead of the whole screen.

x.description: X pixel coordinate, paired with y: tap location, pinch center, or scroll/swipe start (requires endX/endY). elementUUID overrides x/y for tap/double_tap/long_press/pinch_zoom.

y.description: Y pixel coordinate, paired with x; same action meanings and elementUUID precedence as x.

endX.description: Ending X coordinate in pixels for scroll/swipe; requires x, y, endY.

endY.description: Ending Y coordinate in pixels for scroll/swipe; requires x, y, endX.

direction.description: Direction for scroll/swipe. Coordinates are calculated from the screen or element bounds. Provide either direction or custom coordinates (x, y, endX, endY); direction takes precedence if both are given. For scroll_to_element, use up/down; default down.

speed.description: Swipe only. slow: deliberate drag; normal: default navigation speed; fast: flick without an initial hold. Use fast for pull-to-refresh and other velocity-sensitive interfaces.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. long_press defaults to 2000 (range 500–10000); scroll defaults to 800. For swipe, prefer speed unless a custom movement duration is needed. For W3C swipe, overrides movement time; speed still sets the initial hold. Ignored by iOS native mobile: swipe (direction, no elementUUID, speed != fast).

scale.description: Required for pinch_zoom: <1 zooms out, >1 zooms in (e.g. 0.5 or 2 for 2x).

velocity.description: Pinch velocity in scale factor per second. Default 2.2. Used by pinch_zoom.

strategy.description: Required for scroll_to_element. Prefer accessibility id > id > platform-native (iOS: -ios predicate string / -ios class chain; Android: -android uiautomator) > xpath (last resort: slow/brittle). name is legacy; class name may match multiple elements; css selector is webview-only. Same priorities as appium_find_element.

selector.description: Locator selector value. Required for: scroll_to_element.

maxScrollAttempts.description: scroll_to_element only: maximum scroll attempts after the initial lookup fails. Default 10.

scrollDistance.description: scroll_to_element only: vertical swipe distance fraction (0.05–1). Ignored when scrollDistancePreset is set. Default 0.45 when neither option is supplied.

scrollDistancePreset.description: scroll_to_element only: small is a light nudge (0.25), medium is 0.45, large is the full default swipe (1). Overrides scrollDistance when set.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_drag_and_drop
baselineTools.description: Perform a drag-and-drop gesture from a source location to a target location. The gesture: long press the source (default 600ms), drag to the target (default 1200ms), then release. Source and target can each be specified as either an element UUID or coordinates. Useful for reordering lists, moving items, drag-to-delete.

sourceElementUUID.description: UUID of source element to drag from. Either sourceElementUUID or sourceX+sourceY must be provided.

sourceX.description: Source X coordinate. Required if sourceElementUUID is not provided.

sourceY.description: Source Y coordinate. Required if sourceElementUUID is not provided.

targetElementUUID.description: UUID of target element to drop on. Either targetElementUUID or targetX+targetY must be provided.

targetX.description: Target X coordinate. Required if targetElementUUID is not provided.

targetY.description: Target Y coordinate. Required if targetElementUUID is not provided.

duration.description: Duration of the drag movement in milliseconds. Default 1200.

longPressDuration.description: Duration of the long press before dragging in milliseconds. Default 600.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_perform_actions
baselineTools.description: Execute raw W3C Actions API sequences for advanced multi-touch gestures not covered by appium_gesture. Use this for custom multi-finger gestures (rotate, three-finger swipe, edge swipes), complex timing sequences, or any gesture requiring precise control over individual touch points. Prefer appium_gesture for standard gestures (tap, scroll, swipe, pinch) — it handles platform differences automatically.

type.description: Input source type. pointer = touch/mouse, key = keyboard, none = pause/timing.

id.description: Unique identifier for this input source (e.g. "finger1", "finger2").

pointerType.description: Pointer type. Use "touch" for mobile gestures. Only for type=pointer.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. Required for pause and pointerMove.

origin.description: Coordinate origin: "viewport" (default) or "pointer" (relative to current position).

actions.description: Ordered list of action steps for this input source.

W3C Actions API input source array. Each entry is one input source (pointer/key/none) with its action sequence. Multiple pointer sources enable multi-touch gestures (e.g. two-finger rotate, three-finger swipe). All sources execute in parallel, synchronized tick-by-tick.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_find_element
baselineTools.description:
Find an element by strategy and selector. Pass its ID as elementUUID to interaction tools. Returns driver attributes as JSON. For drivers supporting elementResponseAttributes, use appium_driver_settings to configure it with shouldUseCompactResponses=false.
Prefer accessibility id > id > platform-native > xpath (last resort: slow/brittle). See strategy for platform-specific guidance.
To scroll until a target is found, use appium_gesture action=scroll_to_element with the same strategy and selector, rather than repeatedly calling this tool.
Vision fallback: appium_ai action=find_element (if enabled).

strategy.description:
accessibility id: cross-platform, fast and stable. id: Android resource-id; iOS accessibility-id alias.
iOS prefer accessibility id > -ios predicate string > -ios class chain; Android prefer accessibility id > id > -android uiautomator. Use xpath last (slow/brittle).
name: legacy; class name: broad matches; css selector: webview only.

selector.description: Selector for the strategy. Do not pass natural-language descriptions; use appium_ai action=find_element for vision.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_find_elements
baselineTools.description: Find all elements matching a strategy and selector. Returns JSON {elements: [{elementId, attributes?}]}; no matches returns {elements: []}. Pass an elementId as elementUUID to interaction tools. Additional driver attributes are preserved. For drivers supporting elementResponseAttributes, use appium_driver_settings to configure it with shouldUseCompactResponses=false. Use appium_find_element when only one match is needed.

strategy.description:
accessibility id: cross-platform, fast and stable. id: Android resource-id; iOS accessibility-id alias.
iOS prefer accessibility id > -ios predicate string > -ios class chain; Android prefer accessibility id > id > -android uiautomator. Use xpath last (slow/brittle).
name: legacy; class name: broad matches; css selector: webview only.

selector.description: Selector for the strategy. Do not pass natural-language descriptions; use appium_ai action=find_element for vision.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_press_key
baselineTools.description: Press navigation keys (BACK, HOME, APP_SWITCH) on Android or physical buttons (HOME, volume, etc.) on iOS/tvOS.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

key.description: Logical key/button to press. On Android: BACK, HOME, APP_SWITCH. On iOS/tvOS: HOME, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, MENU, PLAY_PAUSE, SELECT.

keyCode.description: Android keycode to press. If provided, takes precedence over key for Android.

isLongPress.description: Android only. Whether to perform a long press. Defaults to false.

baselineTools.name: appium_set_value
baselineTools.description: Enter text into an element

w3cActions.description: When true, type text via the W3C Actions API (performActions) instead of the driver-specific setValue. No elementUUID needed — key events are sent to whatever element currently has focus. Works on both Android and iOS.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_keyboard
baselineTools.description: Hide the software keyboard or check if it is visible (Android UiAutomator2 / iOS XCUITest). action=hide uses mobile: hideKeyboard; action=is_shown uses mobile: isKeyboardShown.

action.description: hide: dismiss the software keyboard (mobile: hideKeyboard). is_shown: whether the keyboard is visible (mobile: isKeyboardShown).

keys.description: hide only: optional key names to dismiss the keyboard (e.g. "done"). Forwarded to mobile: hideKeyboard when non-empty. Ignored for is_shown.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_get_text
baselineTools.description: Get text from an element

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_get_element_attribute
baselineTools.description: Get the value of an element attribute. Use this to check element state (enabled, selected, checked, focused, displayed, clickable) or read properties (name, value, label, content-desc, resource-id, class).

attribute.description: The attribute name to retrieve. Common attributes: "enabled", "selected", "displayed", "checked", "focused", "clickable", "scrollable", "focusable", "name", "value", "label", "text", "content-desc", "resource-id", "class", "package".

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_clipboard
baselineTools.description: Read or set the device clipboard as plain text (Android UiAutomator2 / iOS XCUITest). action=get returns current text; action=set requires content.

action.description: get: read device clipboard as plain text. set: write plain text to the clipboard.

content.description: Required when action is set. Plain text to put on the clipboard.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_get_active_element
baselineTools.description: Get the currently active/focused element and return its UUID for follow-up interactions. [PRIORITY 1: Use this first when you need to find what element currently has focus]

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_get_page_source
baselineTools.description: Get current-screen XML. saveToFile=true returns server-local path/bytes and enables selector/pattern summaries.

saveToFile.description: Save fresh XML to a file; return path/bytes instead of XML.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_orientation
baselineTools.description: Get or set the device/screen orientation. Supports action=get and action=set (LANDSCAPE or PORTRAIT).

action.description: Use get to read current orientation, set to change orientation.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_alert
baselineTools.description: Handle system alerts with action=accept|dismiss, or read alert text with action=get_text.

action.description: Action to perform on alert: accept, dismiss, or get_text

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

buttonLabel.description: Optional label of the button to click for accept/dismiss.

baselineTools.name: appium_screenshot
baselineTools.description: Take a screenshot and save as PNG. Optionally provide elementUUID to capture only that element.

elementUUID.description: Capture this element; omit for the full screen.

maxWidth.description: Resize to at most this width in pixels, preserving aspect ratio.

returnRawBase64.description: Return inline PNG instead of saving, for explicit manual use when the server file is inaccessible. LLMs must keep false and use the saved path.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_get_window_size
baselineTools.description: Get the width and height of the device screen in pixels. Useful for calculating coordinates for swipes, taps, and scrolls.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_screen_recording
baselineTools.description: Start or stop screen recording. action=start begins recording; action=stop stops and saves to MP4.

action.description: start begins recording; stop ends, retrieves, and saves it.

timeLimit.description: Recorder limit in seconds; it does not retrieve/save automatically, so call stop. iOS default 180/max 4200; Android default 180/max 1800.

forceRestart.description: Restart and discard any active recording; default false.

videoQuality.description: iOS only. Video quality preset. Default: medium.

videoFps.description: iOS only. Frames per second. Default: 10.

videoType.description: iOS only. Video codec to use (e.g. libx264).

videoScale.description: iOS only. Width:height, each 1–16384 (e.g. 1280:720); one may be -1 or -2 to preserve aspect ratio.

pixelFormat.description: iOS only. Output pixel format (e.g. yuv420p).

hardwareAcceleration.description: iOS only. FFMPEG hardware acceleration backend.

videoSize.description: Android only. Frame size in WIDTHxHEIGHT format (e.g. 1280x720).

bitRate.description: Android only. Video bit rate in bits per second.

bugReport.description: Android only. Display timestamp overlay. Requires API level 27+.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_app_lifecycle
baselineTools.description: Manage app lifecycle, installation, state, data, and deep links.

action.description: activate: foreground app; terminate: stop app; is_installed: check installation; clear: clear app data without uninstalling (all require id or name). install: requires path. uninstall: requires id/name; Android keepData is optional. list: optional iOS applicationType. query_state: get state 0=not installed,1=not running,2=background suspended,3=background,4=foreground (requires id or name). background: send foreground app to background; optional seconds (default 5). deep_link: requires url; id/name is optional.

id.description: Android package or iOS bundle ID; takes precedence over name.

name.description: Human-readable app name resolved to an ID; alternative to id.

path.description: App file path or HTTP(S) URL; required for install. Embedded URL downloads require ALLOW_REMOTE_APP_URLS=true (default). Remote sessions resolve app inputs on the remote Appium server.

keepData.description: Android uninstall: preserve app data and cache.

applicationType.description: iOS list filter: User (default) or System.

seconds.description: Background duration; default 5. Use -1 to remain in background.

url.description: URL for deep_link (e.g. https://example.com or myapp://path).

waitForLaunch.description: Android deep_link: wait for the activity to return; default true.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_mobile_permissions
baselineTools.description: Get/update Android app permissions or iOS Simulator privacy services; reset iOS privacy prompts. See action-specific parameters.

action.description: get: list (Android) or read one privacy state (iOS Simulator). update: grant/revoke (Android) or set privacy map (iOS Simulator). reset: restore a privacy prompt for the app under test (iOS only).

id.description: App ID; overrides name. Android defaults to the app under test; required for iOS get/update.

name.description: App name resolved to an ID. Android defaults to the app under test; alternative to id for iOS get/update.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

permissionFilter.description: Android get only: which bucket to return. Defaults to requested per UiAutomator2.

service.description: iOS get: privacy service name (e.g. camera, microphone, photos). iOS reset: service name or numeric XCUIProtectedResource id.

permissions.description: Android update only: permission name(s), `all` (with pm target), or appops names. Required for Android update.

permissionChangeAction.description: Android update: for pm target grant (default) or revoke; for appops allow, deny, ignore, default.

access.description: iOS update only: map of access rule → yes|no|unset|limited (Simulator + AppleSimulatorUtils). Required for iOS update.

baselineTools.name: appium_context
baselineTools.description: Manage Appium contexts with one tool. action=list returns all contexts and current context. action=switch changes to a target context.

action.description: Use list to fetch contexts or switch to change context.

context.description: Required when action is switch. Common values: NATIVE_APP or WEBVIEW_<id>/WEBVIEW_<package>.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: generate_locators
baselineTools.description: Generate current-page locator candidates for inspection. Defaults: controls for UiAutomator2/XCUITest/Web; all elements except hierarchy for other native drivers.

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of an element tag or attribute value (name, label, text, ID, etc.). Searches all element types, including hidden elements. Blank or omitted keeps the default driver-specific filter.

xpathAttributes.description: Additional XPath attribute names in priority order, e.g. AutomationId or data-testid. Tried before built-in attributes; defaults remain as fallback. No namespace prefixes or XPath expressions.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

baselineTools.name: appium_generate_tests
baselineTools.description: Return a workflow to execute the scenario with MCP tools, then generate test code from observed interactions. Prefer appium_find_element; generate_locators is for broad inspection.
